paper.title_en: Landau-Ginzburg Theory of a Holographic Superconductor: A Horizon Perspective on the Zero-Temperature Ground State
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the effect of a quartic scalar self-interaction, $λ|φ|^4$, on a holographic superconductor in which non-linear electrodynamic couplings generate a superconducting dome containing an extended Lifshitz regime. The quartic interaction leaves the linearized scalar dynamics around the normal phase unchanged while modifying the non-linear solutions where the scalar field is large. As $λ$ increases, the solutions within the dome pass through three stages. The Lifshitz region shrinks until its scaling solution disappears at $λ^*$, leaving a no-AdS region, beyond whose edge the flows end before reaching any asymptotic region, and above $λ_c$ the dome consists entirely of asymptotically AdS hairy black holes. At the bottom of the dome we identify the point where the horizon value of the scalar field is largest, which we refer to as the critical point. There this value lies at the deepest symmetry-breaking minimum that the horizon effective potential, of Landau-Ginzburg form, can have. Unlike a conventional Landau-Ginzburg description, this interpretation rests on the scalar field at the horizon rather than on the boundary order parameter. Below $λ^*$, the constant scalar of the Lifshitz fixed point sits instead at the minimum of the effective potential of its asymptotic scaling region.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究全息超导体中四次标量自相互作用对零温基态与超导穹顶结构的影响，并借助视界有效势的Landau-Ginzburg形式给出视界视角的解释，属于全息凝聚态物理的核心议题。理论构造（非线性能动耦合、Lifshitz标度区、渐近AdS毛发黑洞）与系统性的相图分析具有一定深度，摘要结构清晰、层次分明，对关注全息超导视界图像与Landau-Ginzburg描述的研究者值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 全息超导体的Landau-Ginzburg理论：零温基态的视界视角
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究四次标量自相互作用 $\lambda|\phi|^4$ 对全息超导体的影响，其中非线性能动耦合产生一个包含扩展Lifshitz区的超导穹顶。四次相互作用不改变正常相附近线性化标量动力学，但会修改标量场较大时的非线性解。随着 $\lambda$ 增大，穹顶内的解经历三个阶段。Lifshitz区收缩，直到其标度解在 $\lambda^*$ 处消失，留下一个无AdS区，在该区边缘之外，流动在到达任何渐近区之前就终止；而在 $\lambda_c$ 以上，穹顶完全由渐近AdS毛发黑洞组成。在穹顶底部，我们确定了标量场视界值最大的那一点，我们称其为临界点。在该点，该值处于视界有效势（具有Landau-Ginzburg形式）所能具有的最深对称破缺极小值处。与常规Landau-Ginzburg描述不同，这一解释依据的是视界处的标量场，而非边界序参量。在 $\lambda^*$ 以下，Lifshitz不动点的常标量改为位于其渐近标度区有效势的极小值处。
